name: Alabama Power Company
description: Alabama Power, a Southern Company subsidiary, is an investor-owned electric utility serving about 1.5 million residential, commercial and industrial customers across the southern two-thirds of Alabama.

name: Allogene Therapeutics
description: Allogene Therapeutics, listed on Nasdaq, develops off-the-shelf allogeneic CAR T cell therapies made from healthy donor cells for patients with lymphoma, kidney cancer and autoimmune diseases.

name: Rent the
description: Rent the Runway runs a U.S. online designer clothing rental service where customers subscribe, rent single items or buy resale pieces from hundreds of brands, and trades on Nasdaq.
note: Debt-for-equity recapitalization closed Oct 2025; lender APS with Story3 and Nexus now major owners; still Nasdaq-listed

name: Pigment
description: Pigment is a Paris-based software company selling an AI-powered business planning and forecasting platform to finance and operations teams at large enterprises, with roughly 700 employees.

name: Pacaso
description: Pacaso runs a marketplace that buys luxury second homes and sells co-ownership shares of one-eighth or more to buyers, operating in about 40 vacation destinations in the U.S. and abroad.

name: Royal Caribbean Cruises
description: Royal Caribbean Group sells cruise vacations worldwide through its Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea brands, operating a fleet of about 69 ships, and is listed on NYSE.

name: State Bank of Pakistan
description: The State Bank of Pakistan is the country's central bank, established under a 1956 act, issuing banknotes, setting monetary policy, supervising banks and serving the federal and provincial governments.

name: Jack in the Box
description: Jack in the Box is a San Diego-based fast-food burger chain, mostly franchised, with about 2,100 restaurants serving U.S. consumers, and its shares trade on Nasdaq.

name: Greenbacker Group
description: Greenbacker is a New York-based independent power producer and investment manager owning about 220 solar, wind and storage projects totalling roughly 2.8 GW, selling power mainly under long-term contracts.

name: Pennymac
description: Pennymac Financial Services originates and services U.S. residential mortgages through correspondent, consumer-direct and broker channels, manages a mortgage REIT, and is NYSE-listed with about 4,900 employees.

name: Cathedral
description: Cathedral is a Washington-area startup building AI-powered offensive and defensive cyber capabilities for the U.S. military and federal agencies, valued at $1.4 billion after a 2026 funding round.

name: rPlus Energies
description: rPlus Energies is a Salt Lake City-based developer of utility-scale renewable and storage projects for utilities, including Utah's 400 MW solar, 1,600 MWh battery Green River Energy Center for PacifiCorp.

name: DIRTT Environmental Solutio
description: DIRTT Environmental Solutions makes prefabricated interior construction systems and design software for workplace, healthcare, education and government buildings, mainly in North America, and is listed on the TSX.

name: Amex Exploration
description: Amex Exploration is a Montreal-based junior miner advancing the high-grade Perron gold project in Quebec toward production, listed on the TSX Venture Exchange with Eldorado Gold as a major shareholder.

name: Rackspace
description: Rackspace Technology provides managed multicloud, private cloud, security and application services on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud to enterprises in finance, healthcare, retail and government, and is Nasdaq-listed.

name: Datadog
description: Datadog sells a cloud monitoring, observability and security platform to software engineering and IT teams, with about 33,400 customers including 48% of the Fortune 500, and is listed on Nasdaq.

name: Kratos Defense and Security
description: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions builds jet drones, hypersonic test vehicles, space and satellite systems and training systems, mainly for the U.S. Department of Defense, and trades on Nasdaq.

name: Origis Energy
description: Origis Energy is a Miami-based developer, owner and operator of utility-scale solar and battery storage projects selling power to utilities and corporate buyers, with about 2.3 GW operating.
note: Portfolio company of Antin Infrastructure Partners since 2021

name: FuriosaAl
description: FuriosaAI is a Seoul-based chip company designing RNGD AI inference accelerators and servers for data centers, cloud providers and enterprises such as LG and Samsung SDS, valued at $2.9 billion.

name: Bombardier
description: Bombardier designs, builds and services Challenger and Global business jets for corporations, charter operators and governments worldwide, employs about 18,000 people and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

name: Under Armour
description: Under Armour, listed on NYSE, sells athletic apparel, footwear and accessories worldwide through wholesale partners, its own stores and e-commerce, with about $5 billion in fiscal 2026 revenue.

name: Echelon Data Centres
description: Echelon Data Centres builds and operates wholesale data centre campuses in Ireland, the UK and wider Europe for hyperscale cloud tenants, with eight campuses totalling about 1.2 GW planned.

name: POET Technologies
description: POET Technologies designs optical engines and light sources built on its optical interposer platform for module makers supplying AI and hyperscale data centres, and is listed on Nasdaq.
